research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: The Ticket Fairy is researching metadata-based generation and management of event presentations. This involves selecting target audiences and programmatically generating multiple presentations and a presentation plan. The technology also includes programmatically executing these plans, aligning with their focus on event ticketing, marketing, and management. This research supports their platform's capabilities in enhancing event presentation and management processes.

press_references.value: Ticket Fairy Launches the World's First Event Ticketing Command Line Built for AI Agents

product_launches.description: Ticket Fairy launched a command line that enables AI assistants and automated systems to perform event-ticketing operations, including reporting, sales-data access, and guest-list management, within assigned permissions.

press_references.value: Ticket Fairy Launches AI‑Powered Operating System for Live Events

product_launches.description: Ticket Fairy launched Ticket Fairy 3.0, an AI-powered operating system that combines AI agents, embedded multi-currency banking (TF Vault) and working-capital financing (TF Capital) for independent live event organizers.

overview_description.description: The Ticket Fairy provides marketing and analytics solutions that help events to get relevant attendees and secure their ticket income. They specialize in social event marketing, ticketing, management, and empowering events and venues.

about_short_description.short_description: The Ticket Fairy is an event ticketing, marketing, management, and revenue acceleration platform.

product.name: Ticket Fairy Platform
product.description: A web-based event ticketing and management platform for creating, selling, and administering tickets for concerts, festivals, parties, conferences, and other live events.

identifier.value: Online Ticket Sales and Event Marketplace

product.name: Online Ticket Sales and Event Marketplace
product.description: A consumer-facing marketplace for discovering events, purchasing tickets, accessing digital tickets, and buying event add-ons such as VIP upgrades, merchandise, parking, and camping passes.

product.name: Referral Marketing and Rewards
product.description: A referral marketing service that gives ticket buyers unique sharing links and provides cash rebates when referred contacts purchase tickets.

product.name: White-Label Ticketing and Integrations
product.description: An integration service that enables organizers to sell Ticket Fairy tickets through their own websites using embeddable widgets, white-label checkout, and API access.

product.name: Ticket Fairy Capital
product.description: An event financing service that provides qualified organizers with advance funding against projected ticket sales to help cover production costs before ticket sales begin.

product.name: Secure Ticket Resale Marketplace
product.description: A resale service that allows eligible ticket holders to resell tickets at face value and enables buyers to receive genuine tickets with updated attendee information.
